commercial-stainless-steel-filtered-cold.shortDescription: Compact filtered commercial water bubbler with 20 L/hr chilled-water capacity, SUS304 stainless-steel cabinet and WaterMark certification for Australian commercial installations.
commercial-stainless-steel-filtered-cold.description:
**What is this model best for?** This round stainless-steel commercial water bubbler is the compact option in the Enviro Aqua range. It is suited to offices, foyers, workshops, sheltered factory areas and other commercial locations where direct chilled drinking water is the main requirement.

**Why choose the round model?** Choose it when you want a simple bubbler-only station with a smaller cylindrical footprint. If users also need to fill bottles or jugs, compare the square stainless and HDPE models, which include a side tap.

**How does it work?** The unit connects to the mains water supply, filters the incoming water through sediment and carbon filtration, chills it to approximately 8–12 °C and dispenses it through the bubbler spout. Rated cooling capacity is 20 L/hr.

**Installation and maintenance.** Use an appropriately licensed plumbing practitioner for the mains-water connection and any required drainage work. The unit uses standard 10-inch filter housings, making replacement sediment and carbon cartridges straightforward to source and service.

faq.q: Is the round commercial water bubbler suitable for an office?
faq.a: Yes. The round stainless model is well suited to offices, foyers and staff areas where direct chilled drinking water is the main requirement and a separate bottle-filling tap is not essential.

faq.q: Can this water bubbler be installed outdoors?
faq.a: Use this stainless model in indoor or sheltered locations. For an exposed outdoor schoolyard, factory yard or sporting facility, choose the rust-free HDPE commercial bubbler instead.

faq.q: Does this commercial water bubbler filter the water?
faq.a: Yes. Incoming mains water passes through sediment and carbon filtration before being chilled and dispensed.

faq.q: How much chilled water can it produce?
faq.a: The rated cooling capacity is 20 litres per hour, with chilled water output of approximately 8–12 °C under the stated operating specification.

faq.q: Who should install this mains-connected bubbler?
faq.a: Use an appropriately licensed plumbing practitioner for the mains-water connection and any required drainage work, and confirm the site-specific installation requirements before fitting the unit.

commercial-water-bubbler-filtered-stainl.description:

**Why choose the square model?** It combines the same 20 L/hr chilled-water performance and filtration as the rest of the range with a flat-sided 30 × 30 cm cabinet and a bottle/glass-fill side tap. Choose the round model when direct drinking is enough; choose the HDPE model when the installation is fully exposed outdoors.

**How does it work?** The unit connects to mains water, filters the incoming supply through sediment and carbon filtration, chills it to approximately 8–12 °C and dispenses through either the bubbler spout or side tap.

**Installation and maintenance.** Use an appropriately licensed plumbing practitioner for the mains-water connection and drainage. Standard 10-inch filter housings keep replacement sediment and carbon cartridges simple to source and maintain.

commercial-rust-free-filtered-cold-water.shortDescription: Rust-free HDPE commercial water bubbler for exposed outdoor sites, with filtration, 20 L/hr chilled-water capacity, bottle-fill side tap and WaterMark certification.
commercial-rust-free-filtered-cold-water.description:
**What is this model best for?** This rust-free HDPE commercial water bubbler is the outdoor-focused model in the range. It suits exposed schoolyards, factory and warehouse areas, sports facilities, pool surrounds and other locations where a metal cabinet would face regular weather exposure.

**Why choose the HDPE model?** The UV-stable HDPE cabinet does not rely on a stainless-steel exterior, making it the strongest choice in the range for exposed outdoor conditions. It also includes a separate side tap for filling bottles, glasses or jugs. Use a stainless model when the installation is indoors or sheltered and a smaller footprint is preferred.

**How does it work?** The unit connects to mains water, filters the incoming supply through sediment and carbon filtration, chills it to approximately 8–12 °C and dispenses through the bubbler spout or side tap. Rated cooling capacity is 20 L/hr.

**Installation and maintenance.** Use an appropriately licensed plumbing practitioner for the mains-water connection and drainage. Standard 10-inch filter housings make sediment and carbon cartridge replacement straightforward as part of a planned maintenance schedule.

faq.a: The rust-free HDPE model is the range option intended for exposed outdoor commercial locations. Its UV-stable polymer cabinet avoids the corrosion concerns associated with exposed metal cabinetry.

faq.q: Is this outdoor bubbler suitable for schools and factories?
faq.a: Yes. It is suited to exposed schoolyards, factory and warehouse areas, sports facilities and other high-use commercial locations where weather resistance and bottle filling are useful.

faq.q: Does the HDPE water bubbler have a bottle-filling tap?
faq.a: Yes. It includes the direct-drinking bubbler spout plus a separate side tap for bottles, glasses and jugs.

faq.q: Is the outdoor water bubbler filtered and chilled?
faq.a: Yes. Incoming mains water passes through sediment and carbon filtration before chilling. Rated cooling capacity is 20 L/hr with approximately 8–12 °C chilled-water output.

faq.q: What installation does the outdoor bubbler require?
faq.a: It is mains-connected and requires site-appropriate plumbing and drainage. Use an appropriately licensed plumbing practitioner and confirm electrical, drainage and weather-exposure requirements for the installation location.
